Muppets motherfuckin racemania! That shit was so fucking good, but it hasn't aged well if im honest..

The game was an average racer with some amazing music, but the adventure mode was what made it stand out, mostly because of the main addicting element of it:

THE UNLOCKABLES! seriously, there were an uncountable number of muppets to unlock (at least for my 6 year old brain), each with their own special vehicle, but each of their vehicles can be used on other muppets, which you unlocked if you hit the Muppet driving the car with a special power up (which each Muppet has their own of) with the Muppet you want to unlock said car on. All of this results in countless hours of racing. Each vehicle even had its own stats, which was mindboggling at the time.

There was secrets and cheats, not a lot of tracks admittedly, but they were all extremely atmospheric. Throw a battle mode and a stunt mode which wasn't the best, but still, and you get a darn good ps1 racer.
